summary_1line: Hanuman recounts to the monkeys his journey to Lanka, meeting obstacles, discovering Sita in Ashoka grove, confronting Ravana, and being captured after wreaking havoc.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman shrinks to a thumb-sized form, darts into the vast open mouth of the serpent-mother Surasa, and instantly flies out again in the middle of the ocean sky.
From the branches of a Shimshapa tree, Hanuman secretly watches the emaciated Sita in the Ashoka grove, surrounded by grim demonesses like a doe encircled by tigresses.
Demons parade Hanuman through Lanka with his tail wrapped in cloth and set ablaze, flames trailing behind the bound monkey as crowds gather along the royal road.
